messages.text: Where can I find a replacement screen for the dc04

You mean the BC04 display — it's a LilyGO T-Display-S3, the H577 version. You can get it here: https://lilygo.cc/en-ca/products/t-display-s3?variant=42351558590645

Worth knowing: the screen Hammer ships is locked down, so you can't reflash it — a fresh one off LilyGO or Amazon is the way. Is yours dead, or just blank?

Got it. If it's the header on the screen itself, that LilyGO board is the fix — swap it in and you're done.

If the broken header is on the BC04 board instead, that's a board-level repair and I don't want to guess at it. Which side is bent up?
